messages:
maya: Hey team — kicking off sunsetting of feature flag `legacy-llm-route` tonight in the 22:00 UTC change window. Plan: 20% -> 0% over 30m in 5 steps, with a canary at 5% for the first 5m. deploy-bot will run the toggle job. @oliver can you watch the canary traces?

oliver: got it. i'll be on pager and watching p95 and error-rate. what are the rollback thresholds?

maya: rollback if p95 latency increases >200ms vs baseline or error rate delta >1% over 5m, or if any 50x spike. also abort if request volume drops unexpectedly.

sam: posting release notes link: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-22-llmroute-sunset : includes migration steps and compat notes.

deploy-bot: Scheduled toggle job created by maya. Job id: `jb-20260322-llm-sunset`. Change window: 22:00-22:45 UTC. Canary at 5% for 5m -> incremental shifts at +5/5/5/5/0.

sre-oncall: FYI i've pre-warmed the safety pool and pinned model version `v8.3.1` on the fallback route for quick drain.

oliver: tagging perf dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/p/perf?view=llmroute — i'll watch p50/p95 and 5m error-rate.

maya: small note: if we see an oscillation during step 3 (15% mark) we should pause and hold for 10m. deploy-bot supports manual hold: `/deploybot hold jb-20260322-llm-sunset`.

deploy-bot: Reminder 10m until job start. Automated health checks enabled: traces anomalies, 5m error-rate, p95 latency, and 429 surge detector.

sre-oncall: i've set an alert on the canary cohort (tag: llm-sunset-canary) with a 3m burn-in threshold.

oliver: can you also add the regression eval set? i'll run the smoke prompts against fallback before step 2.

maya: good call — running quick local eval now, will paste results in 3m if anything odd.

sam: ops note — clients using the old route: batch job owners were mailed, most have migrated; one long-tail tenant (tenant-42) needs manual redirect if we fully close. we will keep a sticky 0% cohort for 24h to allow fat-client retries.

deploy-bot: Job `jb-20260322-llm-sunset` starting now (22:00 UTC). Performing canary flip to 5%.

oliver: canary metrics look stable at +10ms p95 and no error increase. proceeding.

deploy-bot: Increment to 10% (step 2).

maya: hold to check trailing quantiles — holding for 7m.

oliver: observed slight 0.3% error blip from a single downstream service, rolling back that upstream change fixed it. metrics returning to baseline. ready to continue.

deploy-bot: Resuming — increment to 15%, 20%, then final 0% target over next 18m.

deploy-bot: Completed incremental shifts. Final route weight for `legacy-llm-route` is 0%. Job `jb-20260322-llm-sunset` finished.

maya: thanks all — final checklist: filed release note, updated internal migration tracker, pinned fallback model version in case of revert, and left a 24h monitoring watch. Closing the change window at 22:45 UTC. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: monitoring watch active for 24h. will escalate if any unusual post-close regressions.

sam: leaving a quick follow-up doc with tenant-42 redirect steps in the release notes.

oliver: all good from perf side. thanks for smooth coordination.

deploy-bot: Incident archive entry (if needed) will be created automatically after 24h if no alerts fired.
